title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $420 on the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2
excerpt: It's a limited-time deal, so you don't have long to save on this combo cleaner.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $400: As of Aug. 5, the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 robot vacuum and mop is down to $879.99 at Amazon. Compared to its full price of $1,299.99, that's $420 in savings.

Credit: Roborock

$879.99 at Amazon
$1,299.99 Save $420

If you're searching for a reliable robot vacuum to have at home — particularly after news of the FCC deciding to ban all new robot vacuums made outside the U.S. — Amazon is a great place to look.

As of Aug. 5, the retailer has dropped a stellar discount on the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 robot vacuum and mop that we think is worth a look while it's still available. Normally priced at $1,299.99, Amazon has knocked this combo cleaner down to $879.99, saving you $420 overall. It's also pretty close to its lowest recorded price of $849.99, which is a great bonus.

Mashable Trend Report

From cleaning up crumbs to mopping up spills, the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 is packed with plenty of power to help keep your house tidy. The 25,000 Pa suction, with a dual anti-tangle system, lifts any dirt, debris, or loose hair that's caught in your carpets and rugs. Plus, its 3.14-inch height means it can easily maneuver under lower furniture to get tucked-away spots, and Reactive AI obstacle recognition helps it avoid any objects while it cleans.

It also features an upgraded mopping system that, according to the store page, provides 8N of downward pressure to scrub dry stains from your hard floors. And for reaching corners, it has a FlexiArm Arc Side Brush to help out.

If you're hoping to have extra cleaning help ahead of fall, don't miss out on this great deal on the Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 at Amazon.

节省超过 400 美元：截至 8 月 5 日，Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 扫地机器人和拖把器在亚马逊的售价为 879.99 美元。 与全价 1,299.99 美元相比，节省了 420 美元。

图片来源：Roborock

亚马逊 $879.99 $1,299.99 节省 $420

如果您正在寻找一款可靠的家用机器人真空吸尘器——尤其是在美国联邦通信委员会决定禁止所有在美国境外生产的新机器人真空吸尘器的消息传出后——亚马逊是一个不错的选择。

截至 8 月 5 日，该零售商对 Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 扫地机器人和拖地机器人进行了大幅折扣，我们认为这款产品仍然有货，值得一看。 这款清洁套装的原价为 1,299.99 美元，亚马逊已将这款组合清洁剂降价至 879.99 美元，总共为您节省 420 美元。 它也非常接近其最低记录价格 849.99 美元，这是一个巨大的奖励。

可混搭趋势报告

从清理碎屑到擦掉溢出物，Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 拥有强大的功能，可帮助您保持房屋整洁。 25,000 Pa 吸力配有双重防缠结系统，可吸走地毯和垫子上的任何污垢、碎屑或松散的毛发。 此外，其 3.14 英寸的高度意味着它可以轻松地在较低的家具下方移动以找到隐藏的位置，而反应式 AI 障碍物识别功能可帮助它在清洁时避开任何物体。

它还具有升级的拖地系统，根据商店页面，该系统可提供 8N 的向下压力，以擦洗硬地板上的干污渍。 为了到达角落，它有一个 FlexiArm 弧形边刷来帮忙。

如果您希望在秋季之前获得额外的清洁帮助，请不要错过亚马逊 Roborock Qrevo Edge 2 的超值优惠。
